attribution: Source: Office of the Auditor General of Nova Scotia, March 2026 follow-up report, Appendix II pp 25–26 and assurance methodology p 24. Numeric status facts and source-reported institutional/audit identifiers only; original report is linked, not republished.
limits: Historical source-reported statuses, not live October 2026 completion findings.
Limited assurance applies to recommendations assessed completed since the prior follow-up. The report states no procedures or assurance for not-completed recommendations.
Organization-by-audit counts are not independently deduplicated recommendation identities; recommendation numbers can occur for multiple organizations.
The three additional 2024 rows refer to one shared recommendation 1.6, not three distinct recommendations. Do not add them to the main 115 total.
No copied recommendation narratives, personal details, cybersecurity technical findings or management-response text are included.
No legal breach, financial loss or current misconduct is inferred from an incomplete recommendation.
Appendix III management updates as of December 31, 2025 are unaudited and are not ingested in this projection.
